localFacts.fact: all4shooters (German edition): three-leg shooting tripods come from the tactical-military field and are popular in PRS, "der dynamischen Variante des Long Range Schießens", and increasingly in German hunting grounds.

all4shooters measured the BOG DeathGrip Infinite CF at 2925 g and 78 cm packed; the rifle rest sits about 150 cm high at full extension and 20 deg, about 28 cm at 85 deg with legs in (low enough for prone); hook takes max. 11,4 kg (25 lb).

Destatis (Mikrozensus 2025): men in Germany are on average 1,79 m (179,1 cm) tall; on the legs alone the Leupold (188 cm) and Fatboy (182 cm) reach above that, the Vortex (171 cm), Primos (157 cm) and BOG (151 cm) do not.
Lufthansa allows a cabin bag of max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm; folded, the Vortex (71 cm), Leupold (74 cm), Fatboy (67 cm) and BOG (78 cm) are all longer and go in checked baggage.
A German seller lists the Vortex Radian Carbon ball head kit at 25 kg max. load (leveling head kit 20 kg).
Local terms: Schießstativ / Zielstock (Dreibein), Kugelkopf, Nivellierkopf, Arca-Swiss-Schiene, Picatinny-Schiene, Gewehrklemme, Anschlag (liegend, sitzend, kniend, stehend).

localPainPoints.pain: Hunters and long range shooters weigh stability against how far they have to carry the tripod.
localPainPoints.fix: Carbon kits for walking (Fatboy 2,7 kg legs, BOG 2,9 kg), the 1,6 kg Primos for all-day stalks; the 3,3 kg Vortex and Leupold when the car or range is close.

quotes.text: Letzten Endes ist eine Frage des Gewichts, das der Jäger wie weit im Revier neben der Ausrüstung noch mit sich herum Tragen möchte.

localPainPoints.pain: Tripods are steadier than two-leg sticks but bulkier and slower to set up.
localPainPoints.fix: Set the tripod up before the shot, widest leg stop, thickest sections first, pack on the hook (English post setup steps); a bipod stays better when you can lie prone.

quotes.text: Übertreffen Zweibeiner in puncto Stabilität, können jedoch sperriger sein und die Einsatzbereitschaft verzögern.

localPainPoints.pain: A tall single stick or thin rest is too wobbly to aim from.
localPainPoints.fix: Height on thick legs alone (Leupold, Fatboy) and an Arca ball head instead of a yoke for precision shots.

quotes.text: Bergstock ist hoch genug, doch als Zielstock mir persönlich zu wackelig.

localGain.point: Standing height checked against the German average height (179 cm): only Leupold and Fatboy reach it on the legs.
